name: informative
prompt: Informative: how much concrete, checkable knowledge the comment adds — facts, mechanisms, first-hand experience, specifics a reader did not already have.

name: civil
prompt: Civil: how courteous and good-faith the comment is toward the people and views it discusses — no contempt, sneering, or personal attacks.

name: concise
prompt: Concise: says what it has to say in few words — no padding, throat-clearing, or repetition — regardless of how much it says.
